subject: Recap + MAP: Redwood + Acme discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference, dylan_brooks@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP: Redwood + Acme discovery call

Hi Sam / Lena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on goals, stakeholders, and dates. TL;DR: Acme wants a low-latency, cost-predictable inference solution for customer-facing features with SOC2-level controls; we proposed a POC using Redwood Private/Dedicated.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes at peak causing degraded UX (p95 target currently >600ms)
- Unpredictable per-token costs across spikes and retries
- Regulatory requirement to keep EU customer PII on-prem / in EU region

Goals we discussed:
- P95 latency <300ms for typical user flows
- Proof-of-concept demonstrating 1M tokens/month footprint with cost estimate
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and KMS integration for keys

Stakeholders (you mentioned):
- Sam Peterson (Product lead) — decision influencer
- Lena Ortiz (Engineering lead) — technical owner for integration
- Michael Chen (CTO) — executive sponsor (pulls procurement)
- Paula Green (Procurement) — contract and budget approvals

Proposed MAP (attached: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) — initial milestones:
1) POC scope & success criteria sign-off — target: 2026-06-18 — owner: Acme (Sam, Lena)
2) Security questionnaire + SOC2 artifact exchange — target: 2026-06-25 — owner: Acme / Redwood
3) Environment provisioning (Redwood Private trial / dedicated nodes) — target: 2026-07-01 — owner: Redwood (Aditya)
4) POC validation & perf testing — target: 2026-08-15 — owner: Acme / Redwood
5) Budget/contract sign & SOW — target: 2026-07-15 (procurement window) — owner: Acme / Redwood

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send an updated MAP with assigned owners and dates based on your procurement timeline (attached).
- Aditya will provision the trial env and share access details.
- Schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with Lena and our infra engineer (Aditya) next week.

Attachment: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — MAP draft)

Thanks — feel free to flag any timeline changes. I’ll follow up with the MAP v2 and SOW draft tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligned with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement window: we have an internal budget review on 2026-07-12 and aim to finalize approvals by 2026-07-15.
- Stakeholders to include on the SOW loop: Michael Chen (CTO) and Paula Green (Procurement lead). I’ve cc’d Lena for technical scheduling.
- Success criteria: can we add an explicit POC KPI for cost per 1k tokens and a regression budget? That will help procurement.

We’re happy to get the MAP v2 and SOW. For the kickoff, next Wednesday (2026-06-17) morning PT works for Lena.

Sam
